name: Vril Refraction
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

Vril Spells and Class Options Although any character of the appropriate class can use them, vril spells particularly complement the vril adept and vrilbound magus archetypes.

For the duration of this spell, you can refract your vril blasts, splitting your vril ray into two. Each ray attack is resolved as a separate ranged touch attack, and each target takes half as much damage or healing as normal (round down).
